title: Voice request handed to an orb agent
summary: On a pale blue field a caret writes a two-line hook, a voice tile grows into a live transcript, a glowing orb answers, then shrinks into an activity card and fans out into reply bubbles in many languages. One continuous camera, no cuts.
use_when: A voice or phone agent that takes a spoken request and acts on it
Showing one request travelling from input to answer to logged result in a single shot
A calm, light, silent product teaser where UI pieces morph into each other
Multilingual support as the closing capability

look.type_style: regular-weight geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; hook line ~5 % H growing to ~8 % H under the push-in; UI text 1.5-3 % H; small uppercase blue label on the card

sfx.event: caret writes the hook and transcript characters
voice tile appears and grows into a pill
status chip of the second card row lands

structure.shot: empty pale blue gradient, a thin caret appears centre, then a 2-word line (names the subject) is written out right to left
structure.camera: static 0.00-0.77 (cells identical except the caret), then static
structure.motion: caret fades in at 0.27 s (±0.25 s); line revealed behind the caret 0.77-1.27 s, easings.outQuint ~15 fr (±0.25 s); hold 15 fr

structure.shot: the first word is wiped and a second 2-word line (the urgency) replaces the line in place
structure.motion: word-swap via caret wipe, old word out and new word in within 15 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint

structure.shot: a rounded square voice tile lands right of the line, its 5 bars fill blue; camera travels left, the line leaves, the tile widens into a pill and a transcript starts typing
structure.camera: push-in ~18 %/s at 2-3 s, then dolly left 364 px/s @1920 at 3-4 s
structure.motion: tile springs.pop scale-in 8 fr (overshoot not measurable), bars fade pale to blue over 15 fr (±0.25 s); pill widens springs.layout ~15 fr (±0.25 s); typewriter ~16 cps

structure.shot: the transcript pill carries a long request sentence (about 8 words) that types on and scrolls left past the bars
structure.camera: near static, transcript scrolls inside the pill at ~12 px/fr @1920 (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: typewriter continues ~16 cps; bars icon slides out left as text fills; easings.linear scroll

structure.shot: the pill becomes a large input field with a round send button; the key 1-word detail of the request types in big, then field and button travel out left
structure.camera: pull-out -18 %/s at 5-6 s, then dolly right-to-left following the field at 6-6.5 s
structure.motion: field morph springs.layout ~15 fr (±0.25 s); word typewriter 0.50-0.77 s in; button separates from the field 6.00-6.27 s, easings.inExpo exit ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a glossy blue glowing orb enters, a small reply pill grows beside it and streams a one-sentence confirmation (about 7 words)
structure.camera: dolly: orb moves left 6.77-7.00 s, then recentres; pan -277 px/s at 8-9 s; slight tilt roll 1-4 deg
structure.motion: orb fades and scales in springs.heavy ~25 fr (±0.25 s); reply pill springs.ui 10 fr (±0.25 s); stream-text 7.27-9.27 s (~4 words/s), status word in blue first; glow halo breathes behind

structure.shot: orb and pill shrink away, a frosted activity card materializes with the small orb as its top-right badge and two logged rows: a handled call with waveform, a booked slot with a calendar icon and a status chip
structure.camera: pull-out -7 %/s at 9-10 s, then slow push +3.6 %/s at 10-11 s
structure.motion: orb shrinks springs.cameraOut ~15 fr into the card corner; card fades in 8 fr (±0.25 s) with rows staggered ~4 fr (±0.25 s), springs.ui

structure.shot: camera climbs past the first row and pushes into the second row until only its status chip remains; the chip slides out left along a thin line
structure.camera: dolly up 380 px/s at 11-12 s, then push-in +27 %/s with pan left 506 px/s at 12-13 s
structure.motion: zoom-tier from card to element on springs.cameraIn ~30 fr (±0.25 s); first row fades out as camera passes

structure.shot: a thin line leads to the centre where a white reply bubble (4 words, a thank-you) fades in and holds
structure.motion: bubble blur-in, opacity 0 to 1 over 8 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint

structure.shot: the bubble shrinks to centre while 6 more bubbles with the same reply in other languages fade in around it and float
structure.camera: pull-out -3.8 %/s at 14-15 s, then drift +2.9 %/s at 15-16 s
structure.motion: bubbles fade in staggered ~4 fr (±0.25 s) at 30-50 % opacity then full; slow drift ~2 px/fr; at 16.00 s they scatter to the edges, easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: empty pale blue mesh gradient holds to the end (a slot for an end card in a rebuild)
structure.motion: none visible; background blobs effectively still

params.brand: any brand.json: accent (bars, orb, chips, card label), bg, fg, display font
params.content.hook: two 2-word lines; the second replaces the first, naming the urgency
params.content.request: spoken request as one sentence, about 8 words
params.content.keyDetail: one word from the request shown big in the input field
params.content.reply: agent confirmation, about 7 words, status word first in accent
params.content.translations: 6 translations of the thanks line for the bubble cloud

notes: One continuous shot: cuts.json has 0 cuts; every boundary is a state change read from the sheets (±0.25 s). Camera numbers from motion.json per second. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): caret-wipe, voice-bars, agent-orb, bubble-cloud. card-grid from the catalogue hint was not seen (only one card). The last 2.56 s are empty background; a rebuild can put an end card there. No product name, logo or URL is ever shown.
